notes.title: Celebrate Easter with Mimpi in Mimpi Dreams!
notes.content:
Celebrate Easter with Mimpi and find all the hidden Easter eggs in the levels!

Each level has a hidden Easter egg that you need to find in order to get the an achievement, also if you will get a new skin for Mimpi!

You can only find these Easter eggs on the next Sunday and Monday (March 27 and 28)

So get out there and find all of the Easter eggs! Good luck! ːCuriousMimpiː

notes.title: Mimpi Dreams is almost here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are hard at work to get everything prepared for the release of Mimpi Dreams tomorrow (this is the sequel to the original Mimpi)! 

The game is a proper port with enhanced graphics and controls prepared for PC and will have all the steamworks features like badges, cards and Steam achievements.
